messages:
Eli Navarro: heads up mock for small screens puts the 'Canary paused' indicator as a top pill and it's overlapping the timeline scrubber on 320px. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/pausetooth-compact.png

Zoe Park: that overlap will cause accidental scrubs. can we make it an anchored toast in the timeline header instead of a pill?

Ravi - Eng: prefer anchored toast. implementation note: we can't reorder DOM for SR reasons, so toast should be absolutely positioned and not change DOM order. add timeline top padding when toast visible or make toast float to the right.

Mina - PM: copy options: "Canary paused" + small line "Traffic routed to stable D Paused automatically". also CTA: "Undo" and tertiary "Details". which do y'all prefer?

Zoe Park: love short primary: "Canary paused". secondary explains source. add :pause_button: icon. keep Undo visible but small to avoid finger collisions.

Ravi - Eng: interaction: make Undo a two-step quick confirm: first tap reveals inline confirm ("Undo canary pause?") with Confirm/Cancel. avoids accidental rollforwards. keyboard: don't auto-focus toast; provide a skip-to-undo link that appears on focus.

a11y-bot: checklist: contrast >=4.5:1 for 12px body, aria-live appropriate (assertive for safety pauses), toast tabindex=-1, skip-link present and visible on focus, respects prefers-reduced-motion.

Eli Navarro: visual: current pale yellow fails contrast. Zoe, can you try #FFD89A with dark 14px primary and 12px secondary? Also max-width 420px, full width <360px.

Zoe Park: will do. also add 12px padding-top to timeline when toast overlays on touch screens. animation: slide from right; fade for reduced-motion; duration <=200ms.

Mina - PM: metrics to instrument: canary_pause_toast_shown, canary_undo_clicked, canary_undo_confirmed, toast_layout_shift. track undo within 2 mins.

Ravi - Eng: technical: set aria-live="assertive" only when pause.reason === 'safety'; otherwise aria-live="polite". toast aria-label should include brief state and action: "Canary paused. Undo available.". set tabindex=-1 so tab order stays at scrubber.

Eli Navarro: action items: Zoe update comps with right-anchored toast + icon + two-line copy + darker swatch; Ravi prototype skip-link and undo microconfirm; Mina add telemetry events and QA checklist. target: next sprint. I'll post updated frames tonight.

Zoe Park: tagging @ravi @mina. Will upload variants and alt small-screen flow. :thumbsup:
